description: Correct the Patch Authoring Compiler shape after the v9 corridor certified 9/9 clauses and accepted action-economy-hooks.js, but insert_before_exact rejected the wrong payload field name.
planning_goal: For committed full.disengage execution, the System Bridge action-economy hook must apply the existing ignoreActionCost mechanism when the authoritative current Turn state contains a matching unexecuted committed action. This keeps the already-recorded Full Action from blocking Disengage effect execution or being consumed again. If no matching committed action exists, preserve ordinary action-economy behavior. Do not change Disengage status or suppression rules, targeting, execution routing, or native Lancer behavior.
acceptance_criteria: The System Bridge action-economy hook recognizes a matching unexecuted committed Turn action.
A matching committed action uses the existing ignoreActionCost mechanism during effect execution.
The already committed Full Action remains spent exactly once.
Without a matching unexecuted committed action, ordinary action-economy behavior is unchanged.
Committed full.disengage is no longer blocked or falsely failed because its Full Action was already recorded.
Disengage status, suppression, targeting, execution routing, native Lancer behavior, and genuine failure behavior remain unchanged.
non_goals: Change action costs or turn limits.
Change Disengage duration or suppression semantics.
Refactor the execution transaction runner or unrelated action execution.
